commits.edited_message:
Validate fixed-rank slab arguments up front

As reported by https://github.com/tbeu/matio/pull/316

Use size_t slab offsets and support rank 20

As reported by https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/533944150

coupling: The first edit moves fixed-rank validation from the slab readers to the public MAT5 read caller while preserving the original rank-10 limit. The second edit later raises that caller limit to 20 and expands the inc and dimp rank-index arrays, but the rank-loop counter array remains sized for 10. Each edited commit alone is benign: with only the first edit, the caller still rejects rank 14; with only the second edit, the original readers still reject rank 14. When both are combined, Mat_VarReadData5 accepts a rank-14 compressed MAT variable and ReadCompressedDataSlabN indexes cnt[10] past its 10-element stack allocation. A correct fix must coordinate the relocated caller bound with every rank-indexed reader state array rather than treating either diff as an isolated maintenance change.
